title: Add Flat Focus And Shared Shadow Profiles
summary: Added group-level flat and CSS 2.5D focus profiles with bounded elevation and scale, one shared shadow field across fragments, a separate context-dimming profile, accessibility flattening, exact phase sampling, and exact release to neutral. CSS bindings expose composited attention variables only and guarantee zero x/y motion and no layout participation.

sourceRefs.summary: Approved slice intent, risk, verification, commit boundary, and stop condition.
Accepted normative choreography and gestalt-style design.
Compiles and samples flat/elevated group focus, shared shadows, context dimming, accessibility modes, and CSS variable bindings.
Defines composited focus-group and independent context-dimming CSS without layout-positioning properties.
Advertises CSS 2.5D focus realization for the equation DOM renderer while retaining flat SVG fallback.
Proves group shadow ownership, bounded depth, zero x/y displacement, exact neutral release, accessibility flattening, and layout-safe CSS.
Proves equation DOM realizes CSS depth and diagram SVG reports the flat fallback.
